Letting myself be tired would just mean more explanations. I already have to explain why I miss things or why I need things louder. I'd rather just walk past our old cafe and keep going.

You are protecting yourself from having to explain the cost again, so you just keep walking past the places that remind you of him. The grief sits right next to that daily exhaustion. How does it feel to carry both of them at the same time?
